resolvedFindings: The selected discovery row URL now requires the exact photo ID filename prefix and an unambiguous secret/size suffix before the CDN request.
Both image validators require PNG header, IHDR marker and IEND marker, rejecting the reviewed truncation cases.
Failed prior-page deletion prevents further navigation or proof publication; whole-dialog cleanup remains registered.
Client discovery validation now enforces page count and complete expected row cardinality.
reviewConclusions: Enabled route rejects invalid body framing and duplicate Authorization before credential lookup; feature switches remain independent and disabled by default.
HTTP request accepts only the exact photo ID and closed canonical discovery-page/revision query, with fresh full owner/public discovery validation.
CDN request has one fixed destination allowlist, manual redirects and no inherited credentials, cookies or referrer.
Stream reads reject oversized declared or observed bodies, wrong length/type/signature, cancellation and observed expired/invalid/negative clock budgets before returning image bytes.

Final linked-grant SQL also checks current installation credential and same linked revision/owner/generation. Independent cancellation and credential changes at that final read cannot return image bytes.
Client image path remains fixed to the authenticated FGA origin; complete-page cache publication and temporary-directory cleanup remain fail closed.

Detailed qualification gates appropriately concern the trusted FGA backend/edge and supported native client path, without requiring a universal guarantee against an arbitrary malicious replacement server.
limitations: No native UI, hosted network, real-account Flickr read, production enablement or real-repository edit was performed.
Signature validation checks bounded response completeness and signatures; it is not a complete image decoder.
Observed 15-second deadline and abort checks are not a hard real elapsed stall guarantee.
Actual edge error/redirect behavior and Lightroom SDK allocation/credential-forwarding behavior require the explicitly scoped qualification evidence.
